questions.stem: 為了節省紙張、保護森林，政府鼓勵民眾用電子發票取代紙本收據。
questions.answer: To save paper and protect forests, the government encourages people to replace paper receipts with electronic ones.
accepted_answers: In order to save paper and protect forests, the government encourages the public to use e-invoices instead of paper receipts.
The government encourages people to replace paper receipts with e-invoices in order to save paper and protect forests.

questions.stem: 這些發票會存在手機裡，好讓民眾隨時查看，也不必擔心弄丟。
questions.answer: They are stored in phones so that people can check them anytime and never have to worry about losing them.
accepted_answers: These invoices are kept in phones so that people can check them at any time and do not have to worry about losing them.
They are stored in mobile phones so that people can look at them anytime and won't need to worry about losing them.

1.explanation_zh: 「為了…」表目的，句首用不定詞 To + 原形動詞（或 In order to），後面加逗號再接主要子句。「節省紙張、保護森林」是兩個並列的目的，to save paper and (to) protect forests 形式要一致（平行結構）；paper 指紙張時不可數。「鼓勵民眾…」是 encourage + 受詞 + to VR。「用 A 取代 B」是 replace B with A，或 use A instead of B；電子發票可以寫 e-invoices 或 electronic receipts（electronic ones）。
evidence: 為了節省紙張、保護森林
用電子發票取代紙本收據
1.strategy_zh: 目的放句首時想 To VR …, S + V；並列的動作用 and 連接、形式一致。
hints: 切成四段：為了節省紙張／保護森林／政府鼓勵民眾／用電子發票取代紙本收據
標的詞彙：save（節省）、protect（保護）、forest（森林）、encourage（鼓勵）、replace（取代）、receipt（收據）
句型框架：To VR₁ … and VR₂ …, S + encourage + O + to replace B with A

2.explanation_zh: 「好讓…」表目的，後面的主詞換成民眾，用 so that + people + can …。「隨時查看」和「不必擔心弄丟」是 can 後面並列的兩個動作：can check them anytime and never have to worry about losing them，形式要一致（平行結構）。發票是「被」存進手機，用被動 are stored；worry about 後面接動名詞 losing。這一句的 They 指上一句的電子發票。
2.strategy_zh: 目的子句的主詞和主要子句不同時，用 so that + S + can …；兩個並列的動作要用同樣的形式。
hints: 切成四段：這些發票會存在手機裡／好讓民眾／隨時查看／也不必擔心弄丟
標的詞彙：store（儲存）、phone（手機）、check（查看）、anytime（隨時）、worry（擔心）、lose（弄丟）
句型框架：S + be + p.p. … so that + S + can + VR₁ … and never have to VR₂ …

In order to save paper and protect forests, the government encourages the public to use e-invoices instead of paper receipts.

2.restructuring_zh: 「這些發票會存在手機裡」表面是主動，實際上發票是「被」存起來，英文改成被動 they are stored in phones（改被動）；「好讓…」的主詞換成民眾，用 so that people can …。

1.translation: In order to save paper and protect forests, the government encourages people to replace paper receipts with electronic invoices.
1.explanation_zh: 「為了…」用 In order to；「鼓勵民眾…」用 encourage sb to V；「用 B 取代 A」用 replace A with B（受詞是被取代的紙本收據）。

2.translation: These invoices will be stored on people's phones so that they can check them at any time and won't have to worry about losing them.
2.explanation_zh: 「會存在手機裡」用未來式被動 will be stored；「好讓民眾…」用 so that 表目的；「隨時」譯 at any time；「不必擔心弄丟」用 won't have to worry about losing them。

1.translation: In order to save paper and protect forests, the government encourages people to use electronic invoices instead of paper receipts.
1.explanation_zh: 「為了……」用 in order to V；「鼓勵民眾……」用 encourage sb. to V；「取代」譯成 instead of paper receipts。

2.translation: These invoices are stored on people's phones so that they can check them at any time without worrying about losing them.
2.explanation_zh: 「會存在手機裡」用被動 are stored on；「好讓」用 so that 加 can；「不必擔心弄丟」用 without worrying about losing them。

issues_zh: 標的句型 PARA（並列 can check … and never have to worry …）沒有被中文自然引出：「隨時查看，也不必擔心弄丟」我自然譯成 can check them at any time without worrying about losing them（without + V-ing），沒有用 and 並列兩個動詞片語。第 4 部分 accepted 全是 and (never) have to worry 的並列寫法，沒有收 without worrying／without having to worry 這種常見而且語意正確的譯法。建議補進 accepted，或把 PARA 從這一句的標的句型拿掉。

status_reason: blind_solver:B 未通過：第 2 題盲譯沒有用到標的句型 ['PARA']：中文題目沒有自然引出這個句型（SPEC §5.7）；第 2 題驗證者對4 部分切分有意見（warn）：標的句型 PARA（並列 can check … and never have to worry …）沒有被中文自然引出：「隨時查看，也不必擔心弄丟」我自然譯成 can check them at any time without worr；判定者人工審查（第 1 輪）：同意退回。第 2 題標的句型 PARA（can check … and never have to worry …）沒有被中文唯一引出：「隨時查看，也不必擔心弄丟」同樣自然譯成 can check them at any time without worrying about losing them（驗證者 B），第 4 部分 accepted 卻只收 and (never／don't) have to worry 的並列寫法，沒有 without worrying／without having to worry，正確的譯文會被扣分。另外題目「會存在手機裡」的「會」，第 1 部分 accepted 沒有 will be stored（common_errors 的說明自己寫了「或 will be stored」，驗證者 A 也寫 will be stored），也沒有 on people's phones（兩位驗證者都這樣寫），規準偏窄而且自相矛盾。重生時改寫中文讓並列結構成為唯一自然的寫法，或把 PARA 換掉並補 without worrying 的寫法；第 1 部分補 will be stored／on people's phones。第 1 題沒有問題。
